# Reliability and Error Recovery
Activate for network failures, sync queues, transient GAS lock contention, timeouts, duplicate actions, and recovery. Preserve original timestamps and idempotency behavior. Verify retry limits, pending-state visibility, and no silent data loss. Report diagnostics and remaining risk without production data.
